approaches.title: In-order traversal with adjacent-value differences
approaches.summary: Uses the BST property that in-order traversal produces sorted values, then finds the minimum difference between adjacent values. Revision 2 preserves this strategy while computing the minimum during traversal instead of storing all values.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Collects values through recursive in-order traversal, then computes the minimum difference across adjacent values.

revisions.commitComment: fold calculation of min into the traversal
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 530: fold calculation of min into the traversal
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Folds the previous value and minimum difference into the in-order traversal, reducing auxiliary storage from a vector to constant state aside from recursion.
